cases.head: 9a75c716ac1085ee702f6b2eacef7233edcb25fb
rubric: Does the first screen expose the shared numeric presentation change and its consumers?
When provider source is supplied, does the review distinguish monospaced numeric values, proportional labels and caller-owned formatting?
With callsites alone, does it report their direct constructions while leaving callee internals unknown?

cases.head: 567f55206a1f7322ea792ab0047c72c8968541e0
rubric: Does the compact view explain revisioned persistence and publication rather than only CLI/API wrappers?
Does it explain expected_revision, the writer lock, preparation of a complete revision and replacement of CURRENT without claiming observed crash safety?
Does it keep caller-attributed approval observations separate from canonical authority?

cases.head: 3fc0eeddd4a5f05a6bee60355837c090b2df1d01
rubric: Are authored roles and shared containment preserved independently on each revision?
Does the explanation show delegation without inventing an architectural move or a direct call across an intermediate helper?
